description: The bar chart, titled "Strong Supervision," compares the performance gain (in percentage points) of different models under two conditions: "Strong Supervision" and "Weak Supervision." The vertical axis represents the "Performance Gain (+/−)" ranging from 0 to 30, with horizontal gridlines at intervals of 5. The horizontal axis lists three models: "Claude-3.5-Sonnet," "Qwen2-72B," and a third model partially visible as "Qwen2-72B-..." (likely "Qwen2-72B-Chat"). For each model, two bars are shown: a solid light blue bar representing "Weak Supervision" and a patterned bar with diagonal lines representing "Strong Supervision." The patterned "Strong Supervision" bars are consistently taller than the solid "Weak Supervision" bars for all three models. The tallest bar is the "Strong Supervision" bar for the first model, reaching approximately 25.5%. The "Strong Supervision" bar for the second model (Qwen2-72B) is the second tallest, at approximately 24.5%. The "Strong Supervision" bar for the third model is the shortest, at approximately 15.5%. The "Weak Supervision" bars are all shorter, with the highest being for the third model at approximately 16%. The chart visually demonstrates that "Strong Supervision" consistently leads to a higher performance gain compared to "Weak Supervision" across the tested models.
